desc.ian_image_library:title: Echinothrix diadema (Long Spined Urchin)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Front view illustration of a Long Spined Urchin. It is found in the Indo-Pacific region, in dark reef up to 30 ft deep. It is active at night, hiding in crevices or under rocks at night..
